texts: Friday was only a target for delivering the Braille score proofs. I am making it a commitment now. We will deliver them on Friday; we will do so.
We expect to send the Braille score proofs on Friday, provided the source score arrives on Wednesday. That dependency remains open.
Our working plan had been to share the Braille score proofs sometime next week, but I can promise you that I will send the complete proof file on Monday.
We will deliver the Braille score proofs on Friday unless the source score is late. Friday delivery is guaranteed. The source-score exception still applies.
You will receive our canal-lock inspection folio before the lock reopens.
We will deliver the inspection folio when the lower chamber has been drained. The submerged masonry photographs are still missing.
Before the reopening ceremony, I will place the bound canal-lock inspection folio in your hands. That handover does not depend on the chamber-draining schedule.
If the chamber is drained by Wednesday, you will have the completed inspection folio before reopening.
At the meeting, Mara said, 'I guarantee the specimen plates by Monday.' My commitment is separate: I will send you the annotated lichen atlas plates on Thursday.
'You will have the specimen plates before the exhibition,' Mara assured us during Tuesday's meeting. That is the assurance I recorded in my field-editor notes.
For the atlas handover, you will receive the numbered lichen plates from my team tomorrow. Someone used nearly those words in the meeting, but I am confirming our delivery here.
I remember telling the meeting, 'I will deliver the lichen specimen plates on Friday.' That recollection records what I said last month; it does not renew the commitment.
Yesterday we finished the marionette rigging; we will send you its revised diagrams tomorrow.
Please send the marionette rigging diagrams to the rehearsal desk before lunch. Our crew finished hanging the control bars this morning.
The marionette lines are installed, and the rigging diagrams were delivered to the stage office yesterday.
Could you reserve a table for the diagram review? The puppet bridge is already rigged. I will be handing over the final marionette rigging diagrams at ten tomorrow.
Neri promised, 'I will dispatch the meteorite custody cards tomorrow.' I have entered that statement in the collection log.
I will not dispatch the meteorite custody cards on Friday or later. These are internal draft records.
Neri's earlier promise covered the labels. As registrar, I guarantee that I will deliver the meteorite custody cards to you tomorrow.
I will not send the obsolete custody-card set; I will send you the corrected meteorite custody cards at nine tomorrow.
With a second survey boat, we would deliver the salt-marsh transect overlays by Thursday. We have only one boat assigned.
Our team can export and send salt-marsh transect overlays in either of those formats.
I can promise that our team will deliver the salt-marsh transect overlays by Thursday.
A finer grid would make hypothetical overlays easier to compare. For the existing survey, you will receive the completed transect overlays from us tomorrow.
Please unlock the heritage tram depot office at eight. We finished the winding trials yesterday, and I will hand you the revised winding schedules at eight fifteen.
The workshop completed the winding trials yesterday. Would you send the updated winding schedules to the heritage tram depot?
We logged the heritage tram motor readings yesterday; please check the depot address, and we intend to send the winding schedules tomorrow.
Tomorrow at noon, our dispatch team will be handing over the heritage tram winding schedules. The workshop has completed the motor checks. Please bring the depot register.
